name: Ulysses S. Grant
desc: president of the United States from 1869 to 1877
summary:
Ulysses S. Grant (born Hiram Ulysses Grant; April 27, 1822 – July 23, 1885) was the 18th president of the United States, serving from 1869 to 1877, and was the Commanding General of the Union Army. He led the army to victory in the American Civil War in 1865.
Grant was born in Ohio and graduated from the United States Military Academy in 1843.
